Haar SO(3) absolute-entry expectations are 1/2; covariance repeated=1/12, shared row/column=2/(3π)-1/4, disjoint=8/(3π²)-1/4, obtained by sphere/great-circle conditioning. Pair-counting gives gamma T0²+(alpha-2beta+gamma)T1+2(beta-gamma)T2. Set w=2+delta, delta=(ai-aj)²/(aiaj)>=0. Cov(Σ|R_ij|,|R_11|)= (128+32π−23π²)/(12π²)>0 via 3<π<22/7; variance difference from cube is 4 c* Σdelta+Var(Σdelta X)>=0, strictly unless cube. Exact minimum -69+96/π+384/π². Independent symbolic covariance simplification and 60k Haar-rotation draws for cube, box (1,2,3), and (.5,1.4,2.8) matched analytic means and variances within sampling error. Simulation is not mathematical proof.
